title: 第267章 什么楼下遛弯的老大爷其实是省长第266章 我
content_zh:
第267章什么？楼下遛弯的老大爷其实是省长？！
“有好处？”
“不错。”敖青点了点头，“其实道友也不必担心，且不说我没有这心思，就算我想，可即使搭上整个龙宫却也未必能对道友不利啊。”
这倒是。
“至于好处……只要阁下与小女用契约之法建立灵魂联系后，阁下便能通过契约的联系感悟小女灵魂中的毁灭法则，道友若能在这个修为便掌握两条法则之力，想必就算在这三千大世界里也可称翘楚了，而小女的灵魂也可凭借道友的力量承载那一丝毁灭法则而不至于灵魂消散，此乃双赢！”
不是两条，是三条。
自己没在敖青面前用过覆天印，显然这老龙也没看出来。
不过敖青说的话倒是没错，这确实是个双赢的好办法。
不过……这其中却还有个谁赢得多，谁赢得少的问题。
毫无疑问，若是按照敖青的办法，那肯定是龙宫赢得更多，毕竟敖润敖雨两姐妹身崩魂散是眼瞅着的事，此法对于她们而言可谓是雪中送炭，但对于自己来说，多领悟一条法则只能算是锦上添花。
成仙的必要条件便是领悟和掌握三千大道里的一条法则，但对于元婴就掌握两条法则，可以预见的还会在未来掌握更多法则的自己来说，多她少她这条法则其实并没有太大所谓。
倒不是云阳斤斤计较，毕竟已经从修仙文盲进化成修仙小白了，现在还隐隐有从修仙小白蜕变成修仙老手的迹象，怎么可能不知道灵魂契约这种东西在任何时刻都是与自身安危与今后道途息息相关的。
“我可以答应，但签订的契约必须用我和敖丙之间的这种契约！”
这是云阳唯一见过、记下来的灵魂契约，而且还是苏沐雪给的，肯定能信！
“这……”
敖青沉吟了一下，他如何看不出来，云阳和敖丙签订的是种极为高明的主仆契约，若是敖润的灵魂签订这种契约，也就意味着自家女儿的性命将完全被云阳拿捏在手里。
但这似乎也是唯一的办法了。
而且错过这个村就没这个店了，谁知道此方世界还能不能找到如此适合的解决之法。
“行！”敖青咬了咬牙。
不管怎么样，先活下去再说！

……
“我不愿意！”
作为一方大型超凡势力，龙宫的清尾速度还不错，短短两日就将龙宫因战破损的地方修复完毕，外围的建筑也修的七七八八，若不是对龙宫特别熟悉的人，恐怕都发现不了龙宫经历过一场大战。
草，要不龙宫里的妖去干土木吧，这搞工程有一手啊。
而在两天后，所谓的“论道会”如期在龙宫举行。
确实也给云阳面子，明明是一群妖，还是在龙宫这种明显是为了妖那庞大体型而建造的建筑里，但他们却纷纷化成了人形。
这场面，像是童话里那种闯入巨人国的人类，或是闯进人类世界的小人似的。
前来参加这次论道会的，有龙宫核心众妖，就是之前和云阳交过手的那几个，还有外围一直没见过面的两个元婴大妖——蛤蟆和海草……
好吧，这俩原来的名字有点长，再加上这俩妖一直没什么存在感，导致云阳确实忘了这俩那比较炫酷的种族本名了。
除此之外，就是大皇子、敖润这俩金丹妖了。
至于人族，除了云阳外，就是和龙宫关系密切的人族势力——九龙湾的两名元婴修士了。
修为弱的那个中年男人云阳记得，是被自己一丝剑意弹晕的，强的那个老头云阳没见过，从其周身散发的灵力波动来看，估计得是师尊那个层次的。
虽然看着平平无奇，和每天上下班时见到的楼下遛弯的老大爷气质差不多，但仔细感知一下就能发现，之所以感觉平平无奇，是因为这柄剑还在“鞘”里，若是这柄剑拔出来，那定要斩断一切！
什么？楼下遛弯的老大爷其实是省长？！
大概就是这种感觉。
不过这两人一见到云阳，就像……形容的不恰当一点就像狗看见Sh……看见肉一样！一个中年如聂风似的帅大叔，一个仙风道骨像老天师模样的老头竟不管不顾的朝云阳扑来！
“师父！就是他！”
“我靠！寻仇去找玄天门纯阳峰吴震（四长老名讳），报恩找玄天门主峰苏沐雪，总之别特么咬我啊！”
看着如同疯狗般的两人，云阳决定，要是他俩催动法术，自己直接给这俩人摁在这，要是这俩真像疯狗似的在物理意义上过来咬自己，那二话不说自己直接就跑的。
第267章什么？楼下遛弯的老大爷其实是省长？！

就算自己的遁术只是堪堪及格也要跑。
主要是打神经病犯法啊！
然而却没迎来想象中的攻击，这一老一少竟直接来了个滑铲，一左一右抱住了云阳的大腿。
“我靠！大傻春你要干什么？！”
“道友！求教学啊！”
content_en:
Chapter 267 What? The old man walking downstairs is actually the governor? !
"Is there any benefit?"
"That's right." Ao Qing nodded, "Actually, fellow Taoist, you don't have to worry. Not to mention that I don't have this intention. Even if I want to, even if I take the entire Dragon Palace, it may not be detrimental to fellow Taoist."
That's true.
"As for the benefits... As long as you and the little girl establish a soul connection through the contract method, you will be able to understand the law of destruction in the little girl's soul through the connection of the contract. If the Taoist friend can master the power of two laws at this level, he must be a leader in this three thousand world, and the little girl's soul can also rely on the power of the Taoist friend to carry the law of destruction without the soul dissipating. This is a win-win situation!"
Not two, but three.
He had never used the Sky Covering Seal in front of Ao Qing, and obviously the old dragon didn't notice either.
But what Ao Qing said is right, this is indeed a win-win solution.
However... there is still a question of who wins more and who wins less.
There is no doubt that if Ao Qing's method is followed, Dragon Palace will definitely win more. After all, the two sisters Ao Run and Ao Yu are about to die before their eyes. This method can be described as a timely help for them, but for myself, understanding one more law can only be regarded as the icing on the cake.
The necessary condition for becoming an immortal is to understand and master one of the three thousand laws. But for Yuanying, who only masters two laws and can foresee that he will master more laws in the future, the law of more or less does not really matter.
It's not that Yunyang is careless, after all, he has evolved from an illiterate cultivator to a novice in cultivating immortals, and now there are still faint signs of metamorphosis from a novice in cultivating immortals to a veteran in cultivating immortals. How could he not know that something like a soul contract is closely related to his own safety and future path at any moment.
"I can agree, but the contract must be signed between me and Ao Bing!"
This is the only soul contract that Yunyang has ever seen and written down, and it was given by Su Muxue, so I can definitely believe it!
"This..."
Ao Qing pondered for a moment, how could he not see that Yunyang and Ao Bing signed an extremely clever master-servant contract. If Ao Run's soul signed such a contract, it would mean that his daughter's life would be completely in Yunyang's hands.
But this seems to be the only way.
And if you miss this village, you won’t have this store. Who knows if this world can find such a suitable solution.
"Okay!" Ao Qing gritted his teeth.
No matter what, let’s survive first!
…
"I don't want to!"
As a large extraordinary force, the Dragon Palace's cleanup speed was pretty good. In just two days, the damaged parts of the Dragon Palace due to the war were repaired, and the surrounding buildings were also repaired. If you weren't particularly familiar with the Dragon Palace, you probably wouldn't have discovered that the Dragon Palace had experienced a war.
Damn it, why don't the monsters in the Dragon Palace do civil engineering? They are very good at engineering.
Two days later, the so-called "Tao Discussion Meeting" was held as scheduled in the Dragon Palace.
It did give Yunyang face. They were obviously a group of demons, and they were in a building like the Dragon Palace that was obviously built for the huge size of demons, but they all turned into human forms.
This scene is like the kind in fairy tales of humans breaking into the land of giants, or the villain breaking into the human world.
Those who came to participate in this discussion meeting included the core demons of Dragon Palace, the ones who had fought with Yunyang before, and the two great Nascent Soul demons who had never met before - Toad and Seaweed...
Well, the original names of these two were a bit long, and the fact that these two demons never had any sense of existence led Yunyang to really forget the real names of these two relatively cool races.
Besides that, there are the two golden elixir demons, the eldest prince and Ao Run.
As for the human race, apart from Yunyang, there are the two Nascent Soul cultivators from Kowloon Bay who are closely related to the Dragon Palace.
buildYunyang remembered that the weak middle-aged man was knocked unconscious by a trace of his own sword power. Yunyang had never seen the strong old man. Judging from the fluctuations of spiritual power emanating from his body, he was probably at the master's level.
Although it looks unremarkable and has the same temperament as the old man walking downstairs that he sees every day when commuting to get off work, but if you feel it carefully, you will find that the reason why it feels unremarkable is because this sword is still in its "sheath". If this sword is pulled out, it will definitely cut off everything!
What? The old man walking downstairs is actually the governor? !
That's probably what it feels like.
But when these two people saw Yunyang, it was like... to describe it inappropriately, it was like a dog seeing Sh... seeing meat! A middle-aged handsome man like Nie Feng, and an old man with an air of immortality like an old master of heaven actually rushed towards Yunyang regardless of the situation!
"Master! It's him!"
"Damn it! Go to Wu Zhen (the name of the fourth elder) of Xuantian Clan's Chunyang Peak to seek revenge, and go to Su Muxue, the main peak of Xuantian Clan to repay your favor. Anyway, don't bite me!"
Looking at the two people who were like mad dogs, Yunyang decided that if they activated their spells, he would directly hold them down. If these two people really came to bite him like mad dogs in a physical sense, he would run away without saying a word.
Chapter 267 What? The old man walking downstairs is actually the governor? !
Even if his escape skills are only passable, he still has to run.
Mainly because it's a crime to hit someone crazy!
However, there was no attack as expected. The old man and the young man actually made a sliding shovel and hugged Yunyang's thighs one on the left and the other on the right.
"Damn it! Dashachun, what are you going to do?!"
"Fellow Taoist! Please teach me!"
